input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and effectively the walk-away case of exclusive foreign venue. It also directly conflicts with Section 28.2, which gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County. We therefore replaced only the jurisdiction and forum words in 28.1 with the preferred New York position, aligning the two provisions and leaving the 28.3 escalation process untouched.

proposal.summary: Replace Singapore governing law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction with New York law and New York County courts.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We moved governing law and venue to our accepted New York position, which also removes the conflict with Section 28.2's exclusive New York County forum. Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with London courts would be acceptable alternatives.

ops.oldText: governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: governed by the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction
